milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining an oak_trapdoor causes it to drop as an item that enters the player's inventory. The player starts with no oak_trapdoor in inventory, so its presence confirms the block was mined. Two oak trapdoors are stacked in the doorway at spawn-relative (1, 1, 6) and (1, 2, 6); mining at least one satisfies the task and grants access to the room. Preferred over count_in_box_at_most because inventory_has is the #1 preference for mine tasks and avoids spatial box edge cases.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a furnace from 8 cobblestone on the crafting table results in a furnace item appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with no furnace in inventory and there is no other furnace source in the scene, so its presence definitively confirms successful crafting. The player must first mine at least 8 of the 14 available cobblestone blocks inside the room using the provided wooden pickaxe, then use the crafting table at spawn-relative (3, 1, 7). Preferred rule type #1 for craft tasks.
